text:
There are long queues on a major UK motorway this morning as planned roadworks have overrun.

Stuck motorists currently suffering through a six-mile-long traffic queue on the M25 anti-clock between J27 (M11) and J25 (Enfield) on Friday morning, June 5.

National Highways has confirmed that, "due to unforeseen circumstances", overnight roadworks have run over their scheduled timeframe. A spokesperson said: "There is no estimate for reopening."This is a live blog. We'll update you on this ongoing incident throughout the morning

While the roadworks have now been completed, two lanes remain shut - with big queues for drivers.

The latest from National Highways suggests motorists might still be waiting for up to 80 minutes on the M25, so drivers should avoid the busy stretch this morning if they are able to.

A spokesperson for the authority said: "The M25 anti clock between J27 (M11) and J25 (Enfield) has reopened following the overnight roadworks.

" Lane 1 and 2 remains closed between J26 and J25 due to emergency works. There are long delays of 80 minutes. Please allow extra time if you're travelling in the area."

As per Google Maps, the traffic queue has now reached a massive 11 miles in length.

Here is a zoomed-out version of the map, with context of the traffic chaos compared with the whole M25 loop.

The M25 loop, including the monster 11-mile long traffic snake (at time of writing)(Image: Google Maps)

Google Maps is currently showing 10 miles of traffic on the M25.

The mapping site also states that the roadworks are set to finish at 11.30am,which gives some sort of timeframe - albeit a lengthy one - in spite of National Highways, which has left the estimated restoration time for the M25 as simply 'unknown'.

People on social media are voicing their frustrations at the standstill traffic on the M25 this morning.

One man named Jimmy King took to X to fume: "Are you having a laugh? Seriously disgusting, people have got work. Couldn’t organise anything, could you? Useless."

Another motorist wrote: "Just hit an hour to travel three miles. Disgraceful."

A third said: "Affecting so many people due to incompetence. Arrival time when I left the house was 6.30am now 8.07am."

.The M25 remains shut to traffic going anti-clockwise between J27 - or, the M11, and J25 - Enfield. Planned overnght roadworks have spiilled into overtime.

Here's a snapshot of the situation at current, taken from a National Highways traffic camera.

Miles of traffic is backed up on the M25 this morning(Image: Traffic Cameras UK)
